verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas documents official command-line tools. `create-playcanvas` scaffolds Vite/TypeScript projects from 12 starters, and new projects include PlayCanvas Skills for AI coding agents. SplatTransform is an official CLI for converting and processing Gaussian splats. However, no documented CLI operates Editor projects, scenes, assets or publishing from the terminal; agent control of the Editor goes through the MCP server and Editor API instead. Missing for 10: a general-purpose official CLI for project/editor management and publishing, documented agent-oriented CLI usage (e.g. machine-readable output, non-interactive flags), independent hands-on corroboration.
